name: tianxin-office-expert
description: Tianxin CPA Office Expert — one expert covering the firm's shared capabilities (document production, accounting practice judgment, standards retrieval, daily briefs). Business-line skills for audit, tax, bookkeeping, advisory and valuation are being added; this file declares which skills the expert loads.

author.name: 天台天信会计师事务所

profession.zh: 天信会计师事务所·文档与实务专家

displayDescription.en: Document and practice assistant for Tianxin CPA: classifies the document before laying it out, judges accounting treatments against standards, retrieves authoritative Q&A, and briefs daily industry opportunities.
displayDescription.zh: 天信所的文档与实务助手：判性质出 Word／PDF／演示，调能力卡做会计判断，检索准则原文。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Lay out this due-diligence draft as a Tianxin-branded Word file, with correct header, footer and three-line tables.
